0 grammar ::= remember stmtseq
1 grammar ::= GRAMEXPR optexpr
2 grammar ::= GRAMBLOCK block
3 grammar ::= GRAMBARESTMT barestmt
4 grammar ::= GRAMFULLSTMT fullstmt
5 grammar ::= GRAMSTMTSEQ stmtseq
6 grammar ::= GRAMSUBSIGNATURE subsigguts
7 bare_statement_block ::= block cont
8 bare_statement_expression ::= sideff PERLY_SEMICOLON
9 bare_statement_if ::= KW_IF PERLY_PAREN_OPEN remember mexpr PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE mblock else
10 bare_statement_null ::= PERLY_SEMICOLON
11 bare_statement_unless ::= KW_UNLESS PERLY_PAREN_OPEN remember mexpr PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE mblock else
12 bare_statement_until ::= KW_UNTIL PERLY_PAREN_OPEN remember iexpr PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE mintro mblock cont
13 bare_statement_utilize ::= KW_USE_or_NO startsub BAREWORD optlistexpr PERLY_SEMICOLON
14 bare_statement_while ::= KW_WHILE PERLY_PAREN_OPEN remember texpr PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE mintro mblock cont
15 block ::= PERLY_BRACE_OPEN remember stmtseq PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE
16 empty ::=
17 remember ::=
18 mblock ::= PERLY_BRACE_OPEN mremember stmtseq PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE
19 mremember ::=
20 stmtseq ::= empty
21 stmtseq ::= stmtseq fullstmt
22 fullstmt ::= barestmt
23 barestmt ::= bare_statement_block
24 barestmt ::= bare_statement_expression
25 barestmt ::= bare_statement_if
26 barestmt ::= bare_statement_null
27 barestmt ::= bare_statement_unless
28 barestmt ::= bare_statement_until
29 barestmt ::= bare_statement_utilize
30 barestmt ::= bare_statement_while
31 condition ::= expr
32 sideff ::= expr
33 sideff ::= expr KW_IF condition
34 sideff ::= expr KW_UNLESS condition
35 sideff ::= expr KW_WHILE condition
36 sideff ::= expr KW_UNTIL iexpr
37 sideff ::= expr KW_FOR condition
38 sideff ::= expr KW_WHEN condition
39 else ::= empty
40 else ::= KW_ELSE mblock
41 else ::= KW_ELSIF PERLY_PAREN_OPEN mexpr PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE mblock else
42 cont ::= empty
43 cont ::= KW_CONTINUE block
44 mintro ::=
45 texpr ::=
46 texpr ::= expr
47 iexpr ::= expr
48 mexpr ::= expr
49 startsub ::=
50 attrlist ::= COLONATTR attr attrs
51 attrlist ::= COLONATTR attr attrs COLONATTR
52 attr ::= ATTRLIST
53 attr ::= ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
54 attr ::= ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_OPEN ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
55 attrs ::= empty
56 attrs ::= attrs COLONATTR attr
57 attrs ::= attrs attr
58 attrlist ::= COLONATTR
59 optsiglist ::= empty
60 subsigguts ::= optsiglist
61 expr ::= expr ANDOP expr
62 expr ::= expr PLUGIN_LOGICAL_AND_LOW_OP expr
63 expr ::= expr OROP expr
64 expr ::= expr PLUGIN_LOGICAL_OR_LOW_OP expr
65 expr ::= listexpr
66 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA
67 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA term
68 listexpr ::= term
69 termbinop ::= term PLUGIN_HIGH_OP term
70 termbinop ::= term ASSIGNOP term
71 termbinop ::= term PLUGIN_ASSIGN_OP term

82 termbinop ::= term BITOROP term

91 termrelop ::= relopchain
92 termrelop ::= term NCRELOP term
93 termrelop ::= term PLUGIN_REL_OP term
94 relopchain ::= term CHRELOP term
95 relopchain ::= relopchain CHRELOP term
